author: N6rL
content:
CitationEnricher implemented and tested.

Files:
- alcanzai-understanding/src/alcanzai_understanding/citation_enricher.py (new, ~430 lines)
- tests/test_citation_enricher.py (new, 37 unit tests)

Key decisions:
- CitationRecord dataclass (frozen): title, authors, year, venue, volume, pages, doi, raw_ref_string, context_sentences, garbage_score
- _RawCitation intermediate dataclass (pre-scoring, mutable)
- _parse_tei_citations: scans <back><listBibl><biblStruct>; authors 'Surname, Forename' format
- _garbage_score: faithfully carried from prototype grobid_processor.py; humanities invariant verified (year 1781/1920/1959 all survive in tests)
- _blocks_to_body_text: joins ABSTRACT/HEADING/PARAGRAPH blocks (bibliography already excluded)
- _build_citation_patterns + _extract_char_context + _extract_contexts: numeric [N], narrative, parenthetical; 50-char bucket dedup
- Input: document.provenance.source_metadata['grobid_tei_xml'] (placed by coordinator #28)
- Output: EnrichmentResult(data={'citations': list[CitationRecord]})

Test count: 126 passed (was 89 before this issue). Rust: clean. ruff: clean. pyright: 0 errors.
Mutation testing: manual gate, M2 milestone-gated (ADR-006). Estimated mutants ~22.
